description: HaitiDocs finds and returns sourced Haiti economic material from a curated public library: search across indicators, documents, World Bank projects, map layers, and news; open a full document or data series with its source attribution and citation; pull cited passages to ground and draft briefings and analytical notes; and retrieve map-layer GeoJSON for display or spatial analysis. Every result carries a source publisher, freshness, and citation, so the app acts as a finder and forwarder rather than the author of the underlying data.

defaultPrompt: Use HaitiDocs to map Haiti's population density.
